For an **independent upper-upscale hotel in Europe**, the initial shortlist usually centers on flexible **collection or soft brands** that preserve the property’s name, design, and local identity while adding global distribution and loyalty.

### Most commonly considered

| Hotel group | Brand | Typical fit |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott** | **Autograph Collection** | Often the benchmark option for distinctive upper-upscale or lower-luxury hotels. Marriott identifies Autograph and Tribute as major drivers of European conversions. ([marriott-international.pressarea.com](https://marriott-international.pressarea.com/en/pressrelease/details/19580?utm_source=openai)) |
| Marriott | **Tribute Portfolio** | Similar independent positioning, generally suitable for more accessible upper-upscale, lifestyle-oriented properties. ([help.marriott.com](https://help.marriott.com/s/article/Article-24483?utm_source=openai)) |
| Marriott | **Design Hotels** | Considered for strongly design-led, owner-driven hotels, although its affiliation model differs somewhat from a conventional franchise. ([help.marriott.com](https://help.marriott.com/s/article/Article-24483?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hilton** | **Curio Collection by Hilton** | A principal competitor to Autograph for distinctive full-service properties; widely used for European urban and resort conversions. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/emea/releases/travel-revival-spurs-hilton-growth-in-uk-europe?utm_source=openai)) |
| Hilton | **Tapestry Collection by Hilton** | Usually considered when the asset sits toward the upscale/lower end of upper-upscale or has a more informal lifestyle proposition. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/emea/releases/hilton-to-double-lifestyle-portfolio-in-emea?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Accor** | **MGallery Collection** | Particularly relevant in Europe. Accor explicitly positions MGallery as an upper-upscale boutique collection and prioritizes conversions. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/collection-brands-handwritten-emblems-mgallery?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hyatt** | **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt** | Upper-upscale-to-luxury collection for historic, iconic or story-rich hotels that want to retain their individuality. ([hyatt.com](https://www.hyatt.com/development/ourbrands/theunboundcollectionbyhyatt?utm_source=openai)) |
| **IHG** | **Vignette Collection** | Generally aimed at the luxury or upper end of upper-upscale. Designed for independent hotels seeking IHG systems without surrendering their name or character. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/our-brands/vignette?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Radisson Hotel Group** | **Radisson Collection** | Relevant for landmark, design-led or high-end upper-upscale/luxury properties, with flexible identity and conversion requirements. ([radissonhotels.com](https://www.radissonhotels.com/en-us/corporate/development-opportunities/our-brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| Radisson | **Radisson Individuals** | A lower-capital, flexible affiliation alternative, although the core positioning is officially upscale; selected “Premier” or boutique properties may compete in upper-upscale markets. ([radissonhotels.com](https://www.radissonhotels.com/en-us/corporate/development-opportunities/our-brands/radisson-individuals?utm_source=openai)) |
| **BWH Hotels** | **WorldHotels Elite, Crafted or Distinctive** | Often evaluated where the owner wants a lighter-touch affiliation and continued independent operation rather than a conventional global-chain franchise. ([worldhotels.com](https://www.worldhotels.com/content/developers/en_US/portfolio.html?utm_source=openai)) |

### More traditional conversion flags

If retaining the independent identity is less important, owners may also evaluate:

- **voco by IHG** — a highly conversion-oriented premium brand with flexible design and individual property character. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/our-brands/voco?utm_source=openai))  
- **Radisson Blu** — especially relevant in Europe because of its established upper-upscale market presence, but generally requires more visible core-brand adoption. ([radissonhotels.com](https://www.radissonhotels.com/en-us/corporate/development-opportunities/our-brands?utm_source=openai))  
- Depending on the asset and market: **Renaissance, Le Méridien, AC Hotels, DoubleTree, Hotel Indigo, NH Collection** or similar full brands, normally with more prescriptive standards and potentially greater conversion capex.

### If the property is closer to luxury

The shortlist may move upward to **Marriott’s Luxury Collection, Hilton’s LXR, Accor’s Emblems Collection, Wyndham’s Registry Collection**, or independent membership platforms such as **Preferred Hotels & Resorts, Small Luxury Hotels of the World, Leading Hotels of the World** and luxury-level WorldHotels collections. Registry, for example, specifically targets independent luxury urban and resort properties. ([marriott-international.pressarea.com](https://marriott-international.pressarea.com/en/pressrelease/details/19580?utm_source=openai))

In practice, the **core European competitive set** is usually:

**Autograph Collection, Curio Collection, MGallery, Tribute Portfolio, The Unbound Collection, Vignette Collection and Radisson Collection**, with **voco, Radisson Individuals and WorldHotels** added depending on positioning, capex tolerance and how much independence the owner wants to retain.
